name: Rheon Systems Sentinel CorpSec Field Loadout
description:
Matte slate-grey ballistic shell jacket over a graphene-weave tac-vest, paired with articulated cargo trousers in charcoal ripstop. Helmet-ready collar, integrated spinal-rig channel running the full dorsal seam, and chrome-arm cutaway cuffs with magnetic closure. Knee reinforcement panels, mag-lock boot interface tabs at the ankle, and a detachable hood with embedded AR visor mount. Corporate insignia patches are Velcro-swappable — contractors change allegiance fast.

Boots are Harkon Siege derivative: steel-composite toe, oil-resistant sole. A low-profile trauma plate carrier sits under the jacket, invisible at a glance.
functionality: Ballistic resistance (Level IIIA equivalent), spinal-rig and chrome-arm compatibility, AR visor mount, detachable hood, mag-lock boot tabs, trauma plate carrier, climate-wicking inner lining, and swappable corponation insignia.
what_it_says: You are a paid instrument of force — professional, replaceable, and dangerous enough that most people step aside.
worn_by: off-duty military transitioning to private sector
story_hooks: The insignia patch on this kit has been swapped six times — the last employer's logo is still faintly visible beneath the current one.
A CorpSec officer wearing this shows up dead in a Tier 2 transit tunnel — the trauma plates were removed before they were killed.
A player character finds this kit in a locker with a note: 'Don't ask who wore it last.'

physical_description.visual_profile: A militaristic corporate silhouette: broad-shouldered and purposeful. The matte slate-grey jacket dominates, creating a imposing geometric form. Visible tech integration along the spine and wrists signals expensive augmentation compatibility. The overall impression is controlled, modular, and designed for rapid reconfiguration. This is a uniform that says authority and deployment-readiness.
physical_description.fit: Deliberately oversized through the torso to accommodate concealed armor and rig channels, but tapered at the wrists and ankles for equipment lock-down. Compression-grade at the shoulders and forearms. The cargo trousers are cut with articulated panels at the thighs and knees—mobility-first, not aesthetic.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-weave synthetic shell (jacket), graphene-composite tactical vest (under-layer), charcoal ripstop polymer (trousers). All treated for fire resistance and electrical insulation.
physical_description.texture: Matte, slightly grippy surface on the jacket—designed to shed moisture and reduce reflection. The cargo fabric has a subtle grid texture from its ripstop weave. Chrome accents are high-polish, creating stark contrast.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte slate-grey dominant, charcoal accents, brushed chrome on wrist closures and boot tabs. No bright colors—designed for low visibility in urban or industrial settings.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap system on chrome arm cuffs, mag-lock tabs at ankle boot interface, friction-fit hood attachment with quick-release pins. Jacket uses a hybrid magnetic zip-and-velcro system.
distinctive_features: Integrated spinal-rig channel running full dorsal seam (for cybernetic spine augmentation compatibility)
Helmet-ready collar with reinforced edge binding
Removable hood with embedded AR visor mount (clips to jacket collar)
Velcro-swappable corporate insignia patches—modular allegiance indicators
Chrome-arm cutaway cuffs (reveals wrist augmentation points)
Mag-lock boot interface tabs (connects to compatible tactical boots)
Low-profile trauma plate carrier concealed beneath jacket
Detachable tactical vest layer (graphene-weave, visible when jacket is open)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate luxury. This is expensive, bespoke equipment. The modular design and seamless augmentation integration marks the wearer as someone with serious Φ and corpo authorization.
physical_description.cultural_context: CorpSec contractor or private military operator. Wearing this signals you work enforcement for a megacorp (Rheon Systems explicitly), or you're a hired gun with enough credentials to rock corporate-grade kit. The swappable patches indicate contract fluidity—you follow the work, not the loyalty.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or very lightly broken-in. Corporate-issued gear is maintained to spec. Minor scuff marks on the chrome accents, perhaps a faint crease at the spine from rig integration, but otherwise showroom-ready. This is not salvage; this is professional equipment.

image_prompt: A sleek cyberpunk operator in full Rheon Systems CorpSec loadout: matte slate-grey ballistic jacket with visible chrome wrist closures, graphene-weave tac-vest partially visible at the chest, articulated charcoal cargo trousers with prominent knee panels. Detachable hood hangs at the collar, AR visor mount catching cold light. Steel-toe Harkon boots, mag-lock tabs gleaming. Model has subtle chrome arm augmentations visible at the wrist cutaways.
